reason: I'd maybe try the free first collab since the café I know sent it, but I'm not paying for a pass when I mostly do barter and DM businesses myself anyway. And connecting my Instagram to a tiny beta app makes me nervous, read-only or not.
objection: Giving an unknown beta app access to my Instagram, plus the pass seems to mean I owe businesses promo videos and the café gets ₹150 off me, so it feels like I'm the one being sold.
would_change_my_mind: If my free first collab actually turned into a paid one, or a couple of creators I follow vouched that Mitra is safe and got them real paid work.
